company.introduction: Marks & Spencer sells food, clothing, home and beauty products through stores and digital channels. Its food offering emphasises own-brand products, while its fashion and home businesses serve customers across everyday and seasonal purchases. The group also reaches customers through international arrangements and its interest in Ocado Retail. Revenue comes from retail sales, with different categories having distinct purchase frequencies and margin structures. Product quality, value and availability influence customer loyalty. The business combines merchandising, supplier relationships and store operations with online fulfilment, while consumer spending, stock management and the cost of running and modernising its retail estate affect performance.

annualReportAnalysis.methodology: Keyword rates are mentions per 10,000 extracted words. Until lexical tone is available, positivity is a labelled proxy comparing year-on-year growth-theme density with pressure/risk-theme density; it is not management guidance or a recommendation.

components.detail: Recency-weighted average of 75 scored days in the latest 90 calendar days; 30-day half-life.

components.label: Emerging themes
components.detail: Change in growth-theme density compared with pressure and risk themes.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
